title: feat: refine Harness settings layout
body:
Code changes: +210 -14\
Tests: +40 -0\
Others: +0 -0

## What

Update the Harness settings layout for both Local and Cloud. Put icon tabs above the full-width search field, use consistent provider logo tiles, and add row dividers and inset spacing. Keep the existing Refresh login buttons.

## Why

The previous toolbar crowded search and the login panels lost width to a left indent. The sticky toolbar could also cover rows while scrolling.

## How

- Add a settings-only logo component using existing bundled assets, with contrast adjustments for light and dark themes.
- Show a neutral dot only beside Connected; other statuses use text. Allow long status messages to wrap.
- Give rows 12px horizontal padding, remove login-panel indentation, and increase local terminal height from 300px to 360px.
- Let the toolbar scroll with the list.

Authentication, installation, and status detection are unchanged. This PR contains only four frontend files.

## Testing

- Harness settings and logo tests: 51 passed.
- Frontend TypeScript check passed.
- Renderer production build passed.
- Before/after screenshot checks passed against baseline `8e0b3b8c4` and this commit at 1440×900 with the same fake daemon/cloud data. Verified both tabs, 12px row padding, and no subtitle.
- Earlier light/dark terminal open/close checks passed with fake REST and terminal bridges. Real account login was not completed.
- The global commit hook ran `npm run lint`, which failed in untouched backend tests, including `claudecode`, `crush`, `fake`, `goose`, and `importer`. The Go lint phase did not run. Used the hook's one-time bypass for this frontend-only commit.
